rows.label: tlk43500142_01_msg0001
rows.name:
What is it, youngster? I meant to
close the mercenary advice office
for today...

rows.label: tlk43500142_01_msg0002
rows.name:
Oh, you're not mercenaries? Sorry,
then. Guess I got the wrong idea.

rows.label: tlk43500142_01_msg0003
rows.name:
I'd still be glad to lend you
a word of advice if there's
anything troubling you, mind.

rows.label: tlk43500142_01_msg0004
rows.name:
I used to lead a mercenary band,
so I can at least give you
some advice.

rows.label: tlk43500142_01_msg0101
rows.name:
Well, if it isn't Vandham. I've
heard all sorts of tales about the
things you've been getting up to.

rows.label: tlk43500142_01_msg0102
rows.name:
In all my years, I never heard of a
mercenary band taking in orphans
from across the land until yours!

rows.label: tlk43500142_01_msg0103
rows.name:
Looks like you're still busy meddling
in other people's affairs. You really
are too kind for your own good.

rows.label: tlk43500142_01_msg0104
rows.name:
Well, I'm not going to stop
you, but try to look out for
yourself too once in a while.
